answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 26275 Country: India Title: I have a milk business , and I Used to mix WATER in my milk until my milk posses 45% fat , But I used to tell to my customer about this mixing of water , and when milk is low fat naturally , then I mix water in milk accordingly , so please tell me that is it legal to mix water or NOT in Islam Question: I have a milk business , and I Used to mix WATER in my milk until my milk posses 45% fat , But I used to tell to my customer about this mixing of water , and when milk is low fat naturally , then I mix water in milk accordingly , so please tell me that is it legal to mix water or NOT in Islam Answer ID: 26275 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1595/1237/D=1431) (1) If the customer is aware of the adulteration, there is no harm in selling water mixed milk. (2) If one does not intend to cheat, there is no harm to mix water in the milk. However, it is better to sell it without mixing water. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
